## Disclosure rule

When a request says all YCloud APIs or all capabilities, disclose `88 API operations + 2 cross-cutting capabilities = 90 coverage rows`, plus `7 excluded-by-product-decision` from the 95-operation snapshot. Preserve `17 API operations + 2 cross-cutting capabilities = 19 coverage rows` for `full-first-wave` and `60 API operations + 2 cross-cutting capabilities = 62 coverage rows` for `full-whatsapp-operations`. Never describe product exclusion as provider deprecation or claim that the Kit covers all 95 operations.

Message payload variants and Webhook event types are request/event shapes, not additional OpenAPI operation rows.
